name: Privatzimmer Zech
beschreibung: Privatzimmer Zech is a guesthouse in Kufstein, just a few minutes' walk from the historic Altstadt. The accommodation offers simple, well-kept rooms with breakfast available. Guests can expect a quiet, family atmosphere in a typical Tiroler residential house. The Festung Kufstein and the pedestrian zone are within easy reach. The guesthouse is an ideal starting point for hikes in the surrounding mountains.
